serverPath.title: Server Path
serverPath.description: Absolute path to a `vscode-json-language-server` executable. Leave empty to use the bundled server.

features.title: Features
features.description: Which parts of the JSON server the editor uses. Turning one off hands it to the next server serving the same file.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Report syntax and schema validation errors in the linter.

autocomplete.title: Autocomplete
autocomplete.description: Offer properties and values from the active schema.

hover.title: Hover
hover.description: Show descriptions from the active schema on hover.

outline.title: Outline
outline.description: Fill the outline panel with the document structure.

format.title: Format
format.description: Format whole JSON documents and selected ranges.

codeActions.title: Code Actions
codeActions.description: Offer JSON source actions such as sorting object keys.

json.title: JSON
json.description: Comment, schema, validation, result-limit and formatting options sent to the language server.

allowComments.title: Allow Comments in .json Files
allowComments.description: Announce `.json` files to the server as JSONC, so comments are accepted instead of reported as "Comments are not permitted in JSON". Trailing commas are still reported, as a warning rather than an error. `.jsonc` files always allow comments. Editors reopen when this changes.

schemas.title: Schemas
schemas.description: JSON Schema associations. Each item accepts fileMatch patterns plus a schema URL or inline schema object.

resultLimit.title: Maximum Results
resultLimit.description: Maximum symbols, colors and other computed items returned for one document.

keepLines.title: Keep Existing Lines
keepLines.description: Preserve existing line positions where possible when formatting.

http.title: HTTP
http.description: Proxy used when the server downloads remote schemas.

proxy.title: Proxy
proxy.description: Proxy URL. Leave empty for a direct connection.

proxyStrictSSL.title: Verify Proxy Certificates
proxyStrictSSL.description: Verify the proxy certificate against trusted certificate authorities.
